rules: Every supplier is an invented regional distributor; the brands it carries are real brands of that market. No real manufacturer or distributor is a counterparty.
Every name was searched on the web with its city on 2026-11-13; no business of that name was found there.

the_cheap_brake_pads.what: The cheap pad of story S6 is a brand that does not exist: the house brand of supplier V2, which does not exist either. It is sold only by V2 and fitted only at west (ledger s6.brand; catalogue.json story_pins.S6).
the_cheap_brake_pads.why: Story S6 says these pads come back four times as often as any other pad. Saying that of a real budget brand in a sales demo would be unfair to it, and nothing in the seed could support it. So no real brand carries the planted comeback rate.
the_cheap_brake_pads.namesake_check: Done in the reconcile pass on 2026-11-13 by web search of each name in quotes with 'brake pads' / «тормозные колодки»: no brand, product line or seller called Calder ValueStop or BREMHOF came back; the Russian query returned only Brembo pages. A search is not a trademark clearance: before either name is shown outside a demo, the trademark registers of the market are to be read.

_meta.ru_only: V9, the steering-rack subcontractor, exists only in the Russian configuration: the Russian catalogue makes the rack job a sublet repair (cost 9 000, price 12 500); the English catalogue fits a remanufactured rack from a parts supplier.
proposed_ledger_rows: delivery rate is set only for the two suppliers of story S6; the others are to be set when the parts part is designed
